claimText: An IFR flight shall not be cleared for an initial approach below the appropriate minimum altitude unless the controller has determined the aircraft's position by ATS surveillance and a lower minimum altitude has been specified for such services.
rationale: Consistent condition for descending below minimum altitude under surveillance.
